description: Asks a domain registrar, live, which names can be registered, and returns up to about a dozen, each with its name, whether it is available and whether it is premium. Availability can change at any moment. Nothing is bought or held; a name is bought from the website's keep page.

query.description: A whole domain name such as sweetcrumbs.com, or a word to build names from such as sweetcrumbs.
